description: This file provides a minimal API client wrapper for a dashboard application, handling fetch requests with timeout, error handling, and base URL configuration via environment variables.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling API errors, encapsulating HTTP status, response data, URL, and method context.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Retrieves the base URL for API requests from environment variables, ensuring no trailing slashes.

methods.name: withTimeout(signal, timeoutMs)
methods.description: Creates an AbortController with a timeout to cancel fetch requests if they take too long.

methods.name: readJsonOrText(resp)
methods.description: Reads response content, attempting to parse JSON if content type indicates JSON, otherwise returning plain text.

methods.name: apiFetch(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, signal } = {})
methods.description: Main function to perform API requests with support for custom method, headers, body, timeout, and error handling.

methods.name: getConfiguredApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the configured backend API base URL, useful for displaying or debugging.

ctags.name: apiFetch
ctags.pattern: /^export async function apiFetch(path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOU/
ctags.signature: (path, { method = "GET", headers, body, timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, signal } = {})
